title: Do LLM agents behave like spins? Response functions, live networks and amplification near tipping points (code, data and replication package)
description: Code, committed results, pre-registrations and the replication package for the study. make replicate-fast (about 55 min on 4 cores) and make replicate (about 16-17 h) reproduce every analysis and figure from the cached model responses, with no API keys and no GPU, and print a pass/fail table per claim. The response cache, pod outputs and simulation units are in the Hugging Face dataset RandallSPQR/social-phase-transitions-llm-cache (CC BY 4.0). Code: Apache-2.0. See replication/README.md.
notes: CHECK before release: creator name, affiliation, ORCID; remove empty fields. papers/*.pdf are third-party (OpenAI) and not covered by the repository licences (LICENSES.md).
